summary: BHP Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the retirement of Mike Henry as an Executive Director effective 30 June 2026. The filing includes an ASX Appendix 3Z notice detailing Henry's cessation as director and his relevant interests in securities, including performance rights and deferred rights under long-term incentive plans. This management change is an abrupt departure of a top executive, constituting a special situation. No financial terms, board recommendation, advisors, or close timeline were disclosed. Watch for any subsequent leadership appointments and potential strategic shifts under new management.
